name: Integrate Contact Form 7 and iContact
author: Renzo Johnson

sections.description:
This plugin connects Contact Form 7 to iContact. When a visitor submits your form, their information is automatically added to your iContact list—no manual exports required.

Features

  • Simple setup with iContact API credentials
  • Use different iContact lists for different forms
  • Single or double opt-in support
  • Opt-in checkbox option
  • Custom field mapping
  • Lightweight and fast

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • iContact account with API access

Disclaimer

This plugin is an independent project by Renzo Johnson. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Contact Form 7, Takayuki Miyoshi, iContact, or any related companies. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Edit any Contact Form 7 form
  4. Open the iContact tab
  5. Enter your iContact API credentials (App ID, Username, Password)
  6. Select your iContact list and map your fields
  7. Save and test
sections.faq:
Where do I find my iContact API credentials?

Log into your iContact account and navigate to the API settings to generate your App ID, Username, and Password.

Can I use different iContact lists for different forms?

Yes. Each form can connect to a different iContact list with its own settings.

Does this support double opt-in?

Yes. You can choose single opt-in or double opt-in (confirmation email required).
